title: Crestline Credit Card Purchases and Qualification for a Promotional Plan
content:
## 1. Posting a purchase

A purchase posts to a Crestline Credit Card account only while charging privileges are open: **the account must be in status active when a purchase posts.** The status is read from the account record.

- A purchase that would take the current balance above the credit limit is declined at the register and never posts; no over-limit fee exists.
- Products not accepted outside Crestline post Crestline tickets only.
- A Mastercard purchase made outside Crestline in a foreign currency adds the product's foreign transaction fee percentage of the amount to the same purchase entry.

## 2. Attaching a promotional plan

A promotional plan attaches to a purchase only when **all** of these hold:

1. the plan is among the plans the product offers;
2. the purchase is a Crestline ticket;
3. the posted amount is at least the product's minimum purchase for that plan; and
4. when the product requires the account to be current, the account has 0 days past due on the purchase date.

A purchase that misses any condition posts as a standard purchase with no plan, and it is never moved onto a plan later.

| Plan offered | Crestline ticket | At or above the minimum | 0 days past due | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | plan attaches |
| no | any | any | any | standard purchase |
| yes | no | any | any | standard purchase |
| yes | yes | no | any | standard purchase |
| yes | yes | yes | no | standard purchase |

## 3. The plan's last day

The plan's expiration date is the purchase posting date plus the plan's length in calendar months, counted to the same day of the month (falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist), minus one day.

Hypothetical dates:

- A 6-month plan on a purchase posted 15 March expires 14 September.
- A 6-month plan on a purchase posted 31 August of a year whose following February has 28 days counts to 28 February (no 31 February exists) and expires 27 February.
